2609.34358.title: FORGE: Form-Optimal Routing of Grounded Evidence for Frozen LLM Agents
2609.34358.paper_summary: In agentic AI systems, frozen foundation models are increasingly deployed as closed-weight API endpoints, making downstream adaptation possible only through the inputs and inference procedures surrounding the model. As a result, for each input query, two coupled decisions largely determine both answer quality and token cost: what evidence to provide and how much reasoning budget to allocate. Fixed defaults along these axes are often suboptimal, misallocating support form or reasoning depth on roughly 80% of queries in our analysis. To address this challenge, we propose FORGE, a unified framework for adapting frozen models through per-query routing over a joint action space that spans both support form and thinking depth. Under an entropy-regularized, cost-aware utility objective, we derive a closed-form Boltzmann routing target and instantiate the policy as a lightweight 269K-parameter factorized router. The routing policy is trained around the frozen host, without any weight access, through a three-stage pipeline: offline arm enumeration, supervised Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation from the Boltzmann target, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refinement with host feedback. Across 5 knowledge-intensive benchmarks and 8 frozen backbones ranging from 7B to 671B parameters, FORGE improves accuracy at 42-45% lower token cost on both main hosts, transfers zero-shot across hosts at lower token cost, and composes with intrinsic thinking budgets where available.
2609.34358.paper_summary_zh: 在代理型 AI 系統中，凍結的基礎模型越來越多地被作為封閉權重的 API 端點部署，使得下游適應只能通過圍繞模型的輸入和推理過程來實現。結果是，對於每個輸入查詢，兩個相互關聯的決策在很大程度上決定了答案質量和令牌成本：提供什麼證據以及分配多少推理預算。在這些方面的固定默認值通常是次優的，在我們的分析中，約 80% 的查詢錯誤地分配了支持形式或推理深度。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了 FORGE，一個統一的框架，用於通過對支持形式和思考深度的聯合行動空間進行每查詢路由來適應凍結模型。在熵正則化、成本意識的效用目標下，我們推導出一個閉合形式的玻爾茲曼路由目標，並將該策略實例化為一個輕量級的 269K 參數分解路由器。該路由策略圍繞凍結的主機進行訓練，無需任何權重訪問，通過三階段管道：離線臂枚舉、從玻爾茲曼目標進行的監督式 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 蒸餾，以及帶有主機反饋的群體相對策略優化 (GRPO) 精煉。在 5 個知識密集型基準測試和 8 個範圍從 7B 到 671B 參數的凍結骨幹上，FORGE 在兩個主要主機上以 42-45% 更低的令牌成本提高了準確性，並在更低的令牌成本下在主機之間進行零樣本轉移，並在可用的情況下與內在思考預算進行組合。
